links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified hospital orthopaedic patient educational articles
links.outcome: Mean combined reading grade level of rewritten vs original articles (target 6th grade)
links.effect: All four GPT models lowered the mean combined grade level; GPT-3.5-Turbo was least consistent and least effective; GPT-4o-Mini and GPT-4o were most effective and consistent regardless of original difficulty. GPT-4o vs GPT-4o-Mini: 0.421% increase in effectiveness.
links.tradeoff: Cost: GPT-4o cost $0.61 for all 35 articles, a 175.38% higher cost than GPT-4o-Mini for the small gain in effectiveness. Accuracy screening found no falsified information or medical inaccuracies.
links.quote: All GPT AI models lowered the mean combined grade level (Table 2).

design_hint: reading-level constraint prompt for LLM rewriting of patient education materials
